description: A popular third-party MCP server run whole and unmodified: the official MCP fetch server (mcp-server-fetch 2026.7.10), whose own serve() runs once per SSE session inside ONE process (only its stdio transport is replaced, workload/mcp_fetch_host.py). The identity is derived from each session's bearer token; the server's code neither reads nor forwards it. Each call fetches http://dest:port/ (the server also fetches /robots.txt first). Same reference (exclusive destination port).
